title: The Ferrers bound for spanning trees in bipartite graphs
summary: We prove Ehrenborg's conjecture that every connected bipartite graph $G$ with parts of size $m$ and $n$ has at most $\frac{1}{mn}\prod_{v\in V(G)} \operatorname{deg}(v)$ spanning trees, and that equality holds if and only if $G$ is a Ferrers graph. The proof is fully formalized in Lean 4.
